overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a quorum of the Selectboard attended and spoke at a Fire District committee meeting as members of the public, without deliberating, so no posted notice was required.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Selectboard attended and spoke at a Fire District Prudential Committee meeting without posting notice, deliberating outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We conclude that, because the Board members did not deliberate, no meeting occurred for purposes of the Open Meeting Law and the Board was therefore not required to post notice.
